statement: Superexponential van der Waerden numbers. Resolves Erdős's superexponential-growth question for van der Waerden numbers. If $`W_r(k)`$ is the least interval length forcing a monochromatic k-term progression in every r-coloring, then $`W_r(k)\gt k^{ck\lfloor\log_2 r\rfloor}`$ for an absolute c > 0, all r ≥ 2 and sufficiently large k, uniformly in r. In particular, $`W_r(k)^{1/k}\to\infty`$ for each fixed r.
